from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
u='https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S2211124725000966-mmc4.xlsx'
headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 Chrome/124 Safari/537.36','Referer':'https://www.sciencedirect.com/','Accept':'*/*','Range':'bytes=0-31'}
try:
 r=urlopen(Request(u,headers=headers),timeout=30)
 b=r.read(32)
 s=f'{r.status}\t{r.headers.get("Content-Type")}\t{r.headers.get("Content-Length")}\t{repr(b)}\n'
except Exception as e:
 s=f'ERROR\t{type(e).__name__}:{e}\n'
open('status.txt','w').write(s)
